title: Interior Page Settings

fields.label: Hero Eyebrow
fields.name: balt_interior_eyebrow
fields.instructions: Optional small gold text above the page title (for example, Institute for). The large title always uses the WordPress page title.

fields.label: Show Gold Section Navigation
fields.name: balt_section_nav_enabled
fields.instructions: Show the optional navigation bar immediately below the page hero. It is hidden if there are no complete links.

fields.label: Section Navigation Links
fields.name: balt_section_nav_links
fields.instructions: Add up to eight links in display order. Use #mission, #offices, #contact, etc. to jump to a Gutenberg block's HTML Anchor; regular page links also work.

sub_fields.label: Destination
sub_fields.name: link
sub_fields.instructions: Select a page or enter an anchor such as #resources.

description: Editor-managed hero eyebrow and optional per-page section links for the two shared interior templates.
